name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At the Stonewrought Dam, suspicious powder puts Loch Modan and Ironforge in danger. Ashlan Stonesmirk in Dun Modr identifies it as unstable Seaforium, which can explode catastrophically when it touches water.

sections.title: A Volatile Discovery
sections.body: Ashlan Stonesmirk recognizes the silver crystals and distinct odor in samples from the Stonewrought Dam as Seaforium. It stays inert while dry, but moisture makes it react violently. An unchecked explosion could blow Ironforge out of the mountain, Ashlan warns.

sections.title: Racing the Clock
sections.body: Ashlan Stonesmirk prepares a disarming colloid to counter the explosive. Neutralizing it requires the colloid, lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII must be warned at once, before moisture triggers disaster.

faq.q: What kind of explosive was found at the dam?
faq.answer: Ashlan Stonesmirk identifies the powder from the dam as Seaforium, marked by silver crystals and a pungent chemical smell.

faq.q: Why is Seaforium so dangerous here?
faq.answer: Seaforium is relatively harmless while dry, but explodes catastrophically when exposed to water. That makes the Stonewrought Dam, which holds back Loch Modan's waters, an extraordinarily hazardous place for it.
Ashlan Stonesmirk is an Alliance dwarven specialist living in the Wetlands. Ashlan has the engineering and chemical expertise to analyze mysterious powders and craft neutralizers.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII oversees engineering and defense concerns in the region from the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan, safeguarding dwarven infrastructure.

faq.q: How can the Seaforium be neutralized?
faq.answer: Ashlan's disarming colloid must be combined with lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear to defuse the chemical reaction.

faq.q: What is the danger to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Ashlan warns that an uncontrolled detonation could cause seismic failure in the surrounding mountain systems, blowing Ironforge out of the mountain.

angles.text: Engineers will recognize Seaforium as an extremely potent volatile compound. It demands delicate handling and precise chemical countermeasures to prevent massive shockwaves.
For the dwarves of Khaz Modan, volatile Seaforium in the hands of explosive saboteurs near the gateway to Dun Morogh and Ironforge is an existential threat.
Alliance defenders must act quickly to help Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII and secure the lowlands before enemy saboteurs shatter strategic infrastructure.
